description: DDT 70 - Atlas des Zones Inondables (AZI) du RUHANS is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by haute-saone.gouv.fr. Mapping of floodfields. April 2008 data. Non-enforceable knowledge document. No known occurrence, studies were conducted using historical knowledge. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DDT 70 — Atlas of Flood Zones (AZI) of Ruhans" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, atlas du ruhans. The listing shows 2017-02-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
